hero.legenda: One decree, written three times: hieroglyphs for the priests, Demotic for the people, Ancient Greek for the administration. Same content, one stone where three dimensions must meet.

bio.texto: Nuno Rodrigues has managed to bring editorial rigour and structural clarity to complex content. Over the past two decades, he has worked with museums, universities, festivals and public institutions on long-form publications, brand systems and exhibition spaces—alongside creative direction and e-commerce strategy for independent brands. Based in Portugal, working remotely worldwide.

clientes.descricao: Organiser of the Feira de São Mateus

blocos.descricao:
Creative direction and project mentoring from idea to production, with sensible critique, honest applause.
For artists, publishers and small teams too close to their own project.

Identity systems, editorial templates, grids, components and documented design rules, ready for handover.
For organisations that produce at volume and need consistency without a designer on call.

Books, catalogues, reports and academic publications — grid, typographic hierarchy, rhythm and detail, page after page.
For authors, universities, institutions and companies that publish long-form documents.

Scenography, stage design, exhibition storytelling, signage and environmental graphics — giving a space a script.
For museums, galleries, heritage sites, theatres and performance venues.

Festival and event branding, applications, signage, print supports and production pipelines, delivered on immovable deadlines.
For venues, festivals and organisations running recurring programmes.

Online shop strategy, structure, content and Shopify implementation, plus the operation that keeps it selling.
For small producers and brands moving from shelf to direct sales.

maquina.availability: Open to remote freelance and part-time engagements.

maquina.remoto: Fully remote from Viseu, Portugal. Western European Time (UTC+0, UTC+1 in summer).
